source_visual_observations: Circle O with inscribed triangle ABC; A above, B left, C lower-right; radii OA and OC; B=70°.
audit.independent_solution: Central angle AOC subtends the same minor arc AC as the70° inscribed angle ABC. Therefore AOC=140°, choice A.
